title: Does reconstructing the target's joint covariate law from published marginals change the standardized contrast?
question: Standardization needs the target's joint covariate law while publications report marginals; when the dependence the marginals leave free is reconstructed wrongly, how much does the standardized marginal contrast move, and when is the reconstruction immaterial?
design: Target covariate laws built from copulas of known dependence with exact marginals; outcome models standardized over joint laws reconstructed under independence and alternatives; bias and coverage against the true target contrast. The decision rule is registered as code (R/07-decision.R, committed 2 August 2026 before the grid was launched); there is no separate protocol document. 224 cells, 476 replicates each.
